name: Femi Kuti
description: Femi Kuti, son of legendary Afrobeat pioneer Fela Kuti, brings his powerful live performance to Berlin. Carrying forward his father's revolutionary legacy, Femi has become one of Africa's most important voices, blending Afrobeat, jazz, and funk with sharp political commentary. His concerts are explosive celebrations of rhythm and resistance, featuring his backing band Positive Force in what promises to be a high-energy night of musical activism and cultural pride.
